column1: # The IMSLP scan each transcription was made from (OpenScore Lieder records the source file id).
# The engraver's page breaks are not the render's, so the measures printed on each scanned page were
# pinned by reading the page and finding its first and last words in the transcription's syllable
# sequence (bench/songs/pin_scan.py). first/last are measure indices, half-open. swap = the print
# stacks the verses the other way round from the transcription (translation on top).
